title: AegisFlow: Training-Free Non-Myopic Path-Safe Guided Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.39825v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pretrained generative models, such as diffusion and flow matching models, have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in synthesizing high-quality data. However, steering their generative trajectories to satisfy strict constraints--such as identity preservation in image editing or obstacle avoidance in robotics--remains fundamentally challenging. While recent training-free guidance methods enforce path-safety, they rely heavily on min-norm controllers that only account for immediate constraint satisfaction. These myopic approaches often yield suboptimal trajectories that hover dangerously close to the boundary, severely restricting the model's ability to optimize toward its target. In this paper, we propose AegisFlow, a training-free, non-myopic path-safe guidance framework that recasts guided generation as a safety-critical optimal control problem with global scope. translated_abstract: 预训练生成模型，如扩散模型和流匹配模型，在合成高质量数据方面展现了卓越的能力。然而，引导其生成轨迹以满足严格约束——例如图像编辑中的身份保持或机器人技术中的避障——仍然是一个根本性的挑战。尽管近期的免训练引导方法能够实现路径安全，但它们严重依赖于仅考虑即时约束满足的最小范数控制器。这些短视方法往往产生在约束边界附近危险徘徊的次优轨迹，严重限制了模型向目标优化的能力。在本文中，我们提出了AegisFlow，一个免训练的、非短视的路径安全引导框架，它将引导生成重新表述为具有全局视角的安全关键最优控制问题。通过将时变障碍函数直接集成到全局……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: AegisFlow提出了一种免训练的非短视路径安全引导框架，将引导生成建模为全局安全关键最优控制问题，通过时变障碍函数使轨迹远离约束边界，在保证路径安全的同时实现更优的生成目标。
en_tdlr: AegisFlow proposes a training-free, non-myopic path-safe guidance framework that recasts guided generation as a global safety-critical optimal control problem, using a time-varying barrier function to keep trajectories away from constraint boundaries while better optimizing toward the generation target.
